summary: Blocked: the entire fix changes tests only. Tests unconditionally used u64 storage although its BitStore implementation requires a 64-bit target, causing test compilation failures on 32-bit targets. The fix adds target guards and substitutes u32 inputs in two slice tests. No implementation code changes, so no valid implementation-only reversal exists. Reversing these changes would modify protected tests and produce a compilation failure rather than a qualifying behavioral failure. No builds or tests were run.
